description: Reviewed DeepClean coupling configurations. Each entry names the detector, the GPS interval it may be applied to, the witness channels, the frequency band, the sample rate, the coupling configuration file (relative to models/deepclean or ML4GW_DEEPCLEAN_MODEL_DIR) and an immutable model revision (SHA-256 of the weights). deepclean.clean re-verifies the hash and reports applicable=false if the in-band ASD does not improve or the out-of-band ASD changes.

configurations.name: H1 60 Hz mains coupling (O4)
configurations.reference: ML4GW/deepcleanv2 60Hz configuration (autoencoder, PSD-ratio loss, 55-65 Hz, 4096 Hz)
configurations.review: self-trained stand-in for the DeepClean team's deployed weights; see docs/PHASE3_DEEPCLEAN_RUN_2026-09-04.md
